description: This file defines a Spring component that listens for authentication failure events related to bad credentials. When such an event occurs, it attempts to find the user by email, increases the failed login attempts count, and locks the user account if the maximum allowed failed attempts is exceeded.

classes.name: AuthenticationBadCredentialsListener
classes.description: A Spring application listener that reacts to failed authentication events due to bad credentials. It manages user fail attempt counts and locks the account upon exceeding maximum attempts.

methods.name: onApplicationEvent
methods.description: Handles the authentication failure event, updates user fail attempts, and locks user if necessary.
